queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_records FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT sex, test_records, AVG(test_records) OVER () AS average_per_sex, SUM(test_records) OVER () AS total_records FROM counts) SELECT sex, test_records, 1.0 * test_records / total_records AS share_of_total, test_records - average_per_sex AS above_average FROM totals WHERE test_records > average_per_sex
